contracts.boundary: Interpolation reaches the target before filtering; filtered/clamped DSP caches need not equal the fourth matrix target. Native tests bind subsequent publication.

contracts.behavior: Configurable scene/voice counts, normalized leaf edits, configured reset defaults with immediate current reset
contracts.boundary: Leaf edit effect only; absolute projection solver, routing/modifiers and weighted scene allocation remain native-tested.

contracts.behavior: Crossfade signed sums and attenuverter rests-at-zero convention
One-way targets override blend mode and disconnect to neutral
Optional gesture storage with arbitrary IDs and pinned-view lifetime
contracts.boundary: Logical slots only; concrete recursive allocation/reclamation and pin predicate are native-tested.

contracts.behavior: Quiescent skipping preserves an unchanged step
contracts.boundary: Conditional theorem; does not prove the C++ bitwise predicate or IEEE rounding.

contracts.behavior: Application Fuego seam retains shared Crunchy and applies global/local processing once per matrix frame
contracts.boundary: Pure global/local warp functions abstract row-specific Fuego math; Froggers native tests exercise the actual seam.
Imported reusable theorem only. Sheaf still uses recursive evaluation; no prepared graph builder is claimed.

contracts.behavior: Reuse scalar nested leaves only with an unchanged fresh raw center and no child/source routes
contracts.boundary: Conditional equality theorem; native edits/cache-overwrite/wiring tests cover concrete invalidation.

contracts.behavior: Hold source-filter state while stopped without gating control-frame edits
contracts.boundary: Abstract filter state; native stopped-noise and frozen-edit regressions exercise integration.

contracts.behavior: Quartiles select target coverage; independent mode-two source counts and geometric magnitudes
contracts.boundary: Exact coverage mapping, rational two-sided source weights and magnitude recurrence. Native exhaustive entropy-ticket tests connect integer sampler weights to this law. Uniform independent RNG inputs, floating-point inversion, gesture dispatch, target selection and allocation remain native-tested.

contracts.behavior: Reuse an unchanged scalar leaf curve and skip absent inactive source slots
contracts.boundary: Conditional behavioral identities only; native curve equivalence, direct-edit/cache invalidation, multi-voice and route removal regressions verify concrete cache/store conditions. No deadline guarantee follows.

contracts.behavior: Exact configured binary32 coefficients, real steady-state response and continuous-band alias rejection
contracts.boundary: Exact-real six-section steady-state transfer: normalized pass band [0,5/48] power [.981,1.0001], stop band [1/8,1/2] power at most .981e-9 and relative stop/pass power at most 1e-9. Physical bands scale with engine rate. Kernel checks complete closed intervals, trig endpoints and strict denominators. No rounded trajectory, startup, FOH/limiter, compiler refinement or full-synth spectral guarantee.

contracts.behavior: Generic conditional state-energy and disturbance algebra; unconditional full-memory recurrence identities
contracts.boundary: Energy/decay/error-budget theorems require FilterState.Certificate; no actual-six-section stability instances are claimed. The generic 512-sample theorem does not describe runtime Reset, which initializes DC histories. Input histories must agree for homogeneous common-input cancellation.

contracts.behavior: Nearest-even binary32/binary64 rounding, subnormal spacing, FTZ/DAZ and local-to-state arithmetic budgets
contracts.boundary: All 30 actual coefficients are zero or normal and bounded by two. Mathematical finite-format operation trace with explicit binary32 operand guards (8) and binary64 guards (16). State composition remains conditional on FilterState.Certificate, not an actual-six-section budget. Native checks bind scalar/batch execution; no compiler/hardware refinement, NaN/overflow or rounded spectral theorem.

contracts.behavior: Fuego discontinuity obstructs inheriting a linear gain bound; final hard bound is nonexpansive
contracts.boundary: Exact integer scramble at knob=1,row=0 with a real floor/remainder input extension. Actual adjacent-float jumps are native-tested. Non-Lipschitz theorem concerns the real extension, not the finite binary32 domain. It refutes unrestricted transportation of the filter error guarantee through the bit warp.

contracts.behavior: Actual output FIR finite-history flush, L1 gain, mixed-precision arithmetic and final bound composition
contracts.boundary: All 287 binary32 taps are freshly exported. Finite convolution model and RNE/FTZ mixed precision with explicit operand/accumulator guards. No output-FIR frequency stopband proof, complete ring-buffer refinement, or unrestricted full-synth alias-free claim.

contracts.behavior: Bounded exact static-target publication after unconditional root filtering
contracts.boundary: Age resets on exact phase-zero target change; increments before eligibility, saturating4096. Post-filter exact target correction is at most1/50000 relative to clamped filtered publication. This is pointwise only, not a universal spectral bound or a guarantee arbitrary histories settle by4096. Native tests bind binary32 execution and Configure reset.

contracts.behavior: A top-level parameter's Compute() whose last call was a fixed point of ComputeAtDepth, with an unchanged key, may be retired: two consecutive calls with the same key and an unchanged carried state make the second a fixed point, and retiring every frame that shares the key gives the state running every Compute gives
contracts.boundary: The partition of ComputeAtDepth's fields into key, carried and derived state (ComputeSplit) is a ruled judgment, checked by the native differentials (parameter_modulation_tests.cpp fixed_point_compute_retirement_matches_full_compute and the frogg3rs Froggers differential), not proved here; fields beyond key/carried/derived are not constrained. The lite steps that run between two Computes (ProcessLitePhase1 rewrites currentDepths_, part of the carried state) are not modelled; the write epoch is what accounts for them in the C++.
